authorization.note: H1.0 freezes commands only. SSH and each command batch require a new explicit authorization.

commands.review: Plain metadata reads plus procd system_board, whose fixed-source implementation reads uname/proc/release/sysinfo only.

commands.command: sha256sum /sbin/reload_config; awk '$5 == "/sbin/reload_config" { print }' /proc/self/mountinfo; for path in /usr/sbin/reload_config_rs /usr/sbin/owrt-reload-config-switch; do if [ -e "$path" ]; then sha256sum "$path"; else printf '%s absent\n' "$path"; fi; done
commands.review: Hashes files and reads mountinfo; it does not invoke the switch or mutate a mount.
Procfs metadata read; no MTD payload is opened.

commands.command: for path in /sys/class/mtd/mtd[0-9]*; do case "${path##*/}" in *ro) continue ;; esac; printf 'mtd=%s\n' "${path##*/}"; for field in name size erasesize writesize type; do printf '%s=' "$field"; cat "$path/$field"; done; done
commands.review: Reads sysfs MTD label and geometry only; skips mtdXro compatibility symlinks and does not open /dev/mtdX.
ubi-utils information command; reports attached UBI devices and volume metadata without update/create/remove ioctls.

commands.command: for path in /sys/bus/mdio_bus/devices/*/driver /sys/bus/spi/devices/*/driver; do [ -L "$path" ] || continue; printf '%s=' "$path"; readlink "$path"; done
commands.review: Reads driver symlink targets to identify the runtime NAND/switch variants.
Reads and filters the kernel ring buffer; deliberately omits dmesg -c and retains raw output privately.
BusyBox-supported filesystem capacity query only; UBIFS does not expose a fixed inode budget through this df applet.

commands.command: for name in ubinfo nanddump fw_printenv sha256sum tar sysupgrade; do printf '%s=' "$name"; command -v "$name" || printf 'absent\n'; done
commands.review: Shell path lookup only; absent programs get an explicit marker and none of the discovered programs is executed.
Reads the local APK database directly; no package-manager process, index write or network access.
Reads only the environment layout configuration. H1-RO-11 remains blocked until this is matched to /proc/mtd and exact source.

commands.command: for name in boot_wait uart_en flag_boot_rootfs flag_last_success flag_boot_success flag_ota_reboot flag_try_sys1_failed flag_try_sys2_failed; do fw_printenv "$name" || :; done
commands.review: Reads only eight exact-source boot variables after the fw_env layout review; never calls fw_setenv or dumps the complete environment.
